purpose: Fictional editorial illustration for the Jeevansphere Foundation homepage; not a photograph or evidence of actual programmes.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished editorial illustration for the hero of Jeevansphere Foundation, an Indian nonprofit for education, healthcare, dignity and community. This is a warm optimistic fictional illustration, not a photograph or documentation of actual beneficiaries. Square composition, full bleed cream background #fffbf4 with a large warm pale apricot sun behind a leafy shade tree. A caring adult Indian woman teacher wearing an understated terracotta kurta sits with a school-age girl and boy, all reading and learning together from an open book around a small table, a second adult in simple plum clothing holds a potted sapling beside them. Respectful, confident, joyful everyday community, varied brown skin tones. A little stack of books and a small marigold plant. High quality contemporary editorial gouache with subtle paper grain, simple expressive faces, organic flowing shapes, beautifully composed with generous negative space at the edges. Restricted warm palette of deep plum #241645, marigold gold #ffc233, terracotta #db3b17, cream and muted sage. Natural anatomy. Main figures occupy the middle 75% and bottom 65%, tree arches overhead. No text, no lettering, no badges, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no fake UI. The image will be displayed in a large rounded rectangle next to a headline on the website.
